login.insuranceNumberHint: You can find it on your insurance card.
login.spitexHelp: Your Spitex (home care) team is happy to help you sign in for the first time.

consultation.title: Please come in for a consultation.
consultation.body: Your weight has gone up by 2 kg in three days. I would like to discuss this with you. No need to worry.

reviewing.label: Doctor is checking
